item.title: Filmhouse opens at Golden Mile Tower, bringing arthouse cinema back to Singapore
item.description: Independent cinema has a new home. Filmhouse officially opens on 3 February at Golden Mile Tower, taking over the former site of The Projector, and marking a fresh chapter for Singapore’s cinephile community. Helmed by Sharon Tan (former GM of The Projector) and Walter Navarro (former head of programming), the new space reunites familiar faces from the beloved venue, with a renewed mission: to spotlight cinema beyond the mainstream and keep the spirit of independent film culture alive. item.title: BTS to stage livestream performance 'THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG', premiere documentary on Netflix in March
item.description: BTS are officially back — and they’re taking over the world stage with a landmark live-streamed event, a new album, and a Netflix-exclusive documentary. On 21 March, BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG will stream live from Gwanghwamun, Seoul’s historic heart, exclusively on Netflix at 8 PM KST. The performance marks the band’s first global comeback stage since their hiatus — and celebrates the release of their new album ARIRANG, dropping 20 March. item.title: Belle and Sebastian to perform 'If You're Feeling Sinister' in full at Singapore concert this September
item.description: Scottish indie icons Belle and Sebastian are returning to Singapore for a special one-night-only show at the Esplanade Concert Hall on 20 September. The band will celebrate 30 years of their seminal album If You're Feeling Sinister by performing it in full — alongside a second set packed with fan favourites. item.description: South Korean soloist WOODZ has officially unveiled the full routing for his Archive. 1 world tour, confirming stops across Asia, Europe, and Australia — with more dates still to come. item.title: Jessica Sanchez is coming home: 'America’s Got Talent' season 20 winner to perform in Manila this May
item.description: After conquering global stages and winning over millions, Jessica Sanchez is finally bringing her powerhouse vocals back to where it all began — the Philippines. The Filipino-American singer and newly crowned America’s Got Talent season 20 Grand Winner is set to headline her first major homecoming show — Jessica Sanchez – Live in Manila, happening on 16 May at the Araneta Coliseum. The concert is presented by Wilbros Live. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Wilbros Live (@wilbroslive)

item.title: Yung Singh and ryota team up for two Asia shows in Singapore & Hong Kong
item.description: Yung Singh is set to return to Asia this March for a pair of tightly curated shows in Singapore and Hong Kong, bringing his dancefloor-driven ethos back to the region. This time, he’s joined by ryota, the Osaka-born selector whose influence runs deep through Japan’s underground scene. The Singapore show takes place on 20 March at MDLR, followed by the Hong Kong date on 21 March at Pier 1929.
